analysis.headline: Sells Your Data (CA Residents)
analysis.quote: You will find below information on how we collect, use, share, transfer and, for California residents only, sell your personal data when you use the services provided on our sites or interact with us.

analysis.headline: Shares for Advertising
analysis.quote: We may also share your personal data collected through our sites with our advertising partners, as set out in our cookie policy.

analysis.headline: Shares with Group Companies
analysis.quote: Depending on where you live, we may share your personal data within the Guardian group of companies in the UK, US, or Australia.

analysis.headline: Shares with Event Sponsors
analysis.quote: We may share your personal data with sponsors of Guardian events and partners who we hold events with for marketing purposes when you have given your permission for us to do so.

analysis.headline: Shares with Affiliate Marketers
analysis.quote: When a product is linked from a Guardian article or gallery, if the retailer has an affiliate programme, then the link will redirect to the retailer website through our affiliate marketing partner, such as Skimlinks’ network.

analysis.headline: Shares for Audience Analysis
analysis.quote: Service providers that help us carry out analytics, facilitate audience creation and segmentation and to measure our audience engagement. For example, Permutive provides us with data management platform services.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Geolocation Data
analysis.quote: Your geolocation data - your IP address can be used to find information about the latitude, longitude, altitude of your device, its direction of travel, your GPS data and data about connection with local Wi-Fi equipment.

analysis.headline: Uses AI with Your Data
analysis.quote: The Guardian may use generative AI functionalities in our software and systems, including in our use of personal data.

analysis.headline: Your Public Comments Are Monitored
analysis.quote: When we moderate comments under our community standards and participation guidelines.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: Personal data we collect may be transferred to, stored and processed in any country or territory where one or more of our Guardian group companies or service providers are based or have facilities.
